LanguageData.DMS_Settings_ArtifuscleRotsDesc: When disabled, Artifuscle no longer rots and does not need to be refrigerated. Takes effect immediately. Artifuscle that has already rotted stays rotted.
LanguageData.DMS_Settings_SituationalMusicDesc: Play DMS music at DMS sites and underground facilities, and during DMS boss encounters and huntdown raids: exploration, alerts, combat, boss fights, lockdowns and aftermaths. When disabled, music is left to the base game and other mods. Takes effect immediately.
